column3: Exact pending CSR commit requires dispatched holder while pre-ROB dispatch valid requires undispatched holder; removing pending_system_csr_commit from dispatch cancel should remove a false combinational dependency without changing holder death.

head0_csr_commit must remain in system_csr_dispatch_cancel because an older lane0 CSR commit can coexist with a younger lane1 pre-ROB SYSTEM holder; removing it can enqueue an orphan ProducerId in the clear cycle.

Mapped Top40 pending_system_csr_commit path count changed 40 to 0 while head0_csr_commit remained 40; WNS improved 0.100259781 ns, TNS improved 1793.90625 ns, area changed minus 0.84, cells and relative fixed-toggle power were unchanged.
Retain ca37 as an engineering candidate only. L0 through L3 and independent RTL review pass, but the 5 ns timing hard gate remains open and absolute power is not qualified.

The standalone admission/cancel gate mutation proves combinational policy only; integrated holder death is supported by arbiter and sequencer paths plus L1 through L3, and dedicated integration mutations are deferred until promotion.

Rollback V15V if a pending SYSTEM holder can redispatch after exact commit, if head0 CSR commit fails to suppress younger lane1 dispatch, if exact-once terminal or RTL assertions regress, or if same-configuration PPA loses the measured monotonic improvement.
